answer: Like a prism splitting dawn light into separate colors, require every agent to stake tokens behind one unique, costly identity before it can bridge into shared markets. The stake locks for the whole epoch and is slashed if the agent is caught duplicating work or voting twice. A new identity must also finish a slow, verifiable proof-of-work task before its first trade, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand slow proofs, far more than any sybil gain. Honest agents keep their stake and earn; fakes bleed.
